description: Abstract class 'AbstractDocumentifier' defining methods for converting SugarBean objects into document-friendly arrays, including phone and email sanitization and metadata handling.

classes.name: AbstractDocumentifier
classes.description: An abstract base class for documentification of SugarBean objects, providing methods for sanitizing phones, fixing emails, and retrieving metadata.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a SugarBean into a document-friendly array.

methods.name: fixPhone
methods.description: Sanitizes phone numbers in the document array.

methods.name: fixEmails
methods.description: Fills in email field if empty, using the bean's email address.

methods.name: sanitizePhone
methods.description: Removes non-numeric characters from a phone number, except '+' sign.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns default metadata fields present in a bean.
